text:
Maria G: Hey folks — PR #8342 is ready but we need architecture/design signoff before merge. Can someone confirm we should attach the RFC and whether this needs a longer canary? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8342

Kevin L: can you drop the RFC link here? also is this blocking the release window or just a docs check?

Maria G: RFC: https://docs.internal.redwood.ai/rfcs/2026-02-kv-cache-routing
Short summary: add routing policy to fallback to smaller KV-cache shards for cold starts. Touches routing, canary config, and client-side hints.

Sanjay R: main concern is SLO delta — do we need a longer canary? current PR sets canary=10% for 24h. If KV-cache misses spike, tail latencies could increase.

Archbot: RFC 2026-02 status: "Under review" — reviewers requested: @Sanjay R, @Leo T. No architecture approval recorded.

Julia P: I can run a quick perf sim tomorrow to model miss-rate increases. If we add a smoke with perf metrics logged to the PR, I can +1 for canary=24h after seeing results.

Kevin L: @Maria G please add the RFC link to the PR description and tag @Sanjay R and @Leo T; also add a short checklist to the PR description: `- perf run attached`, `- canary plan`, `- fallback test (simulate shard eviction)`.

Maria G: done — PR description updated with RFC and checklist. pinging @Sanjay R @Leo T for arch eyes. Thanks :pray:
PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8342

Ops-Bot: NOTE: merging without arch approval will trigger a policy block: see infra/merge-policy.md — merge will be prevented until required approvals are present.

Leo T: I'll take a look first thing AM. If Julia's perf run looks good and the checklist is complete, I can provide the arch ack and we can schedule merge in the next release window. :+1:
